title: Final Energy Expressions
description: Essential criteria include correct expressions for the energy shifts of the 1s and 2s-2p states.

title: Qualitative Energy Shifts
description: Important criteria involve a clear explanation of how energy levels shift and the physical reasoning behind differences among states.

title: Perturbation Hamiltonian
description: Important criteria require the correct formulation of the perturbation Hamiltonian for the muonic atom.

title: Approximation Validity
description: Important criteria include a discussion on the conditions under which the first-order perturbation method fails.

title: Energy Shift Estimation
description: Optional criteria involve a correct estimation of the energy shift for the 2s-2p states under the given assumptions.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional criteria include a physical interpretation of why the method may overestimate or underestimate energy shifts.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall criteria identify common mistakes such as neglecting the effects of the nuclear size on energy shifts.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall criteria check for consistency in units throughout calculations and expressions.
